name: Guntherus Cisterciensis
pdTranslations: Historical English translation from Reformation era
modernTranslations: The Capture of Constantinople: The Hystoria Constantinopolitana of Gunther of Pairis appears to have modern translation
untranslatedHighlights: Most works beyond Historia Constantinopolitana appear untranslated

name: Agobardus Lugdunensis
pdTranslations: Medieval French translation of Against the Absurd Opinions (19th c.)
modernTranslations: W.L. North translation of De insolentia Iudaeorum; other works have academic translations
untranslatedHighlights: Many of his 26 works lack comprehensive English translation; scattered translations in scholarly articles

name: Bernaldus Constantiensis
modernTranslations: No English translations located
untranslatedHighlights: All 14 works appear to remain in Latin; manuscript editions available at Documenta Catholica Omnia

name: Orosius
pdTranslations: Old English Orosius (9th-10th c.); Irving Woodworth Raymond translation 1936
modernTranslations: Andrew T. Fear translation (Liverpool University Press 2010, Translated Texts for Historians 54); Malcolm Godden edition (Dumbarton Oaks Medieval Library)
untranslatedHighlights: None; comprehensive coverage exists

name: Symmachus
modernTranslations: Michele Renee Salzman and Michael Roberts translation of Book 1 of letters (SBL 2011, Brill 2012); Roman Letters website offers online translations; R.H. Barrow translation of Relationes (1973)
untranslatedHighlights: Only Book 1 of 10 books of letters fully translated; other books remain largely inaccessible in English

name: Ratramnus Corbeiensis
pdTranslations: Multiple medieval English translations (1532, 1548, 1581, 1624, 1686, 1838, 1880); 1838 version The Book of Ratramn widely available
modernTranslations: G.E. McCracken translation in Library of Christian Classics vol. 9 (1957)
untranslatedHighlights: De corpore et sanguine Domini has good coverage; other works less certain

name: Hugo Eterianus
modernTranslations: Italian translation of De sancto et immortali Deo (Corpus Christianorum in Translation vol. 48)
untranslatedHighlights: No comprehensive English translation; Contra Patarenos survives in Latin manuscripts only

name: Adrianus IV
modernTranslations: Bolton and Duggan eds., Adrian IV the English Pope (2004) includes substantial appendix of papal privileges and charters with English translations
untranslatedHighlights: Scattered English translations of his works in academic collections; no comprehensive complete works translation

name: Algerus Leodiensis
modernTranslations: No English translations located
untranslatedHighlights: De misericordia et iustitia and De sacramento remain in Latin; studied through Latin editions only

name: Auctor incertus (Rabanus Maurus?)
modernTranslations: N/A - uncertain authorship
untranslatedHighlights: Anonymous/collective entry; cannot assess translation status reliably

name: Guerricus Igniacensis
modernTranslations: Monks of Mount Saint Bernard edition, Cistercian Fathers (CF) 8 and CF 32 (1971, 2 volumes); Thomas Merton partial translation The Christmas Sermons of Bl. Guerric of Igny (Gethsemani Abbey KY, 1959)
untranslatedHighlights: None; 54 liturgical sermons comprehensively translated

name: Lucifer Calaritanus
modernTranslations: English translation of Concerning Athanasius only; other anti-Arian polemics remain untranslated
untranslatedHighlights: Four of five polemical tracts lack English translation; most important works inaccessible in English

name: Isaac de Stella
modernTranslations: Hugh McCaffery translation (1979); Daniel Deme ed., Selected Works of Isaac of Stella (Routledge); Lewis White complete sermons translation; multiple recent editions available
untranslatedHighlights: Ten sermons first translated in Deme edition; earlier translations may be incomplete by modern standards

name: Hariulfus Aldenburgensis
modernTranslations: No English translations located
untranslatedHighlights: Chronicon Centulense and hagiographic works remain in Latin; important source for abbey history inaccessible in English

name: Hugo Rothomagensis
modernTranslations: No English translations located
untranslatedHighlights: Seven works remain in Latin only

name: Calixtus II
modernTranslations: Codex Calixtinus (Liber Sancti Jacobi) available in various editions with translations; academic editions of papal privileges
untranslatedHighlights: Works beyond Codex Calixtinus less accessible; council decrees and formal documents scattered across collections

name: Hermannus Contractus
modernTranslations: John L. Snyder revised edition of Musica with annotated English translation on facing pages (Eastman Studies in Music 128)
untranslatedHighlights: Musica well-translated; other works (history, astronomy, time-keeping treatises) less accessible in English

name: Goffridus Vindocinensis
modernTranslations: No modern English translations located
untranslatedHighlights: Sermons, hymns, theological tracts, and letters remain in Latin; Sirmondiana edition standard but Latin only

name: Clemens III
modernTranslations: Scattered translations of papal privileges in academic collections; some materials available in Wikisource
untranslatedHighlights: Comprehensive English translation of his complete pontifical writings not readily available

name: Leo IX

modernTranslations: N/A - uncertain authorship

name: Henricus Huntingdonensis

name: Henricus de Castro Marsiaco

name: Aldhelmus Schireburnensis
modernTranslations: Aldhelm, the Prose Works (English translation addressing difficulty of original Latin); scholarly edition available
untranslatedHighlights: Prose works translated; poetry (carmina) and some letters may have less complete coverage

name: Eucherius Lugdunensis

modernTranslations: De contemptu mundi available in modern editions; incomplete coverage of other works
untranslatedHighlights: De laude eremi (In Praise of the Desert) never translated to English; exegetical works (Formulae spiritualis intelligentiae, Instructiones) status unclear

name: Marbodus Redonensis

name: Arnobius Afer

name: Thietmarus Merseburgensis

name: Eckbertus Schonaugiensis
